change: Allowlisted structured source-location reporting for failed Records fixture, without raw recovery data.
modernSchema: Direct Failure Message child of exactly validated case, exact canonical source path, bounded integer one-based line. Actual non-Records checkout and hosted StoreKit examples confirm convention; multiple conflicting lines are rejected.
